title: Hand ScleroDerma Lived Experience Scale in Individuals With Systemic Sclerosis
off: Investigation of the Turkish Validity and Reliability of the Hand ScleroDerma Lived Experience Scale (HAnDE Scale) Questionnaire in Individuals With Systemic Sclerosis
summary: The aim of this study was to examine the Turkish validity and reliability of the Hand scleroDerma lived Experience Scale (HAnDE Scale) Questionnaire in individuals with SSc.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being diagnosed with Systemic Sclerosis by a rheumatologist
* Being 18 years of age or older,

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of neurological disease
* Presence of any orthopedic problem that will affect functionality
* Presence of orthopedic surgery history
* Inability to speak or understand Turkish fluently.
* Presence of psychiatric disease that will affect cooperation.
* Severe neurological disease that will affect hand functions (peripheral nerve lesion, trauma, operation, cerebrovascular accident).
* Heart failure and lung pathology that will affect daily living activities.

primary.m: Hand ScleroDerma Lived Experience Scale (HAnDE Scale) Questionnaire
primary.tf: Evaluations started immediately after receiving ethics committee approval and will be completed within 6 months, which is the study period.
